title: Damiano's and dovetail mates
line: The queen beside the king on a diagonal, guarded, with the king's own pieces behind it.

steps.text: Damiano's mate: a pawn guards the square next to the king where the queen will land. The king's own rook and pawn block it in.

steps.hint: The queen goes up the edge to the square the pawn guards.
steps.after: Checkmate. Your pawn guards the queen and takes f7, and the king's own rook and pawn take the rest.

steps.text: The dovetail: the queen checks from diagonally next to the king, guarded, and the king's own pieces fill the two squares behind it.
steps.hint: The queen goes up the open file to the square your pawn guards.
steps.after: Checkmate. The rook and pawn behind the king block it, and the queen takes every other square.

steps.text: Now you are Black, and White threatens Damiano's mate on h7. Your own rook blocks your king: move it.

wrong.a7a6: Then the queen comes to h7, and it is mate.
wrong.b7b6: Then the queen comes to h7, and it is mate.
wrong.a8e8: Then the queen comes to h7, and it is mate.
wrong.d7e6: Then the queen comes to h7, and it is mate.

steps.hint: Move the rook that stands beside your king.
steps.after: The king can step aside now, so the queen on h7 is no longer mate.

summary: A guarded queen beside the king on a diagonal mates when the king's own pieces fill the squares behind it.
